name: Alyshia Cooper
original_name: アリューシャ・クーバー
source:
Member of Student and belongs to horn-race.

Came to Voromia after Soshie whom Alyshias family has served for generations and she is continuing doing so. Has strict character and is expert swordsman. Sees potential in Abel early on.
